# A circular draft just short of its apex

The radius is 2 and the inset is 2 − 10⁻⁸. The angle of 45° gives
an axial height equal to that inset. The desired frustum has
a top radius of about 10⁻⁸. Its volume, area and centroid follow
the formulas from `tapers/disc-frustum`.

`oracle.json` records `program.py` through CadQuery 2.3.0 and Open
CASCADE 7.9.3.0. The oracle accepts the cone in the collapse
limit. Arris 0.12.0 refuses the short meridian edge.
